It was aired alongside ''[[M04|Celebi: The Voice of the Forest]]''. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== At a giant beachside mansion, Pikachu and some of its buddies decide to play a game of hide-and-seek. Pikachu is “it,” and it goes off in search of its friends. Meanwhile, Larvitar, sick of being all by itself, kicks a rock in anger. The rock hurtles through the air—and hits a lawnmower, turning it on and sending it tearing off after Pikachu and its friends! The group draws the lawnmower into a maze and even gets it into the water, but the lawnmower just keeps on chasing. The Pokémon build a road out of logs, hoping to get the lawnmower into a shack, but Psyduck trips and ruins the whole setup. How will the friends ever escape the lawnmower? This fantasy will have you on the edge of your seat! ==Plot== {{AP|Pikachu}} and his friends are at a beach. Pikachu and {{TP|Misty|Togepi|Togetic}} run into the water as the tide recedes and run away when the tide comes in. {{AP|Totodile}} is having fun in the shallow water, kicking it around. {{TP|Misty|Psyduck}} is floating in an inner tube before a huge wave knocks it out of the water. {{AP|Bayleef}} and {{AP|Cyndaquil|Quilava}} are napping, until Totodile uses its {{m|Water Gun}} to blast Cyndaquil, making Cyndaquil chase after him. Four {{p|Corsola}} walk by, and Togepi follows them, into the ocean. Pikachu sees Togepi and races over to try to help it; luckily for Pikachu, a {{p|Wailmer}} appears and launches Togepi into the air with a water spray. A passing {{p|Yanma}} flies by, catching Togepi on its back, and sets it down on dry land. Once Yanma flies away, the gang chases after it, coming upon a massive mansion. At the mansion, a {{p|Larvitar}}, {{p|Kecleon}}, and {{p|Granbull}} are patrolling the garden, with Larvitar in charge. Larvitar orders Granbull to right a fallen chair, then fixes a rock on a planter, when the gang shows up. Togepi follows a few {{p|Sunkern}}, bouncing up and down with them into the open, knocking over the rock that Larvitar fixed, making Larvitar angry. Pikachu and the gang run out to defend Togepi. Unlike Larvitar, Granbull and Kecleon seem happy to find new friends. Granbull barks loudly, calling out a {{p|Sunflora}}, {{p|Oddish}}, {{p|Sandshrew}}, {{p|Azurill}}, and {{p|Donphan}}, who introduce themselves. Larvitar wants no part in the camaraderie and walks away. To start off the fun, Pikachu picks up a small stick with a leaf hanging on one side and tosses it into the air. The others try to blow the leaf away from themselves. Finally, the leaf falls and lands towards Pikachu. Pikachu was 'it' and runs to start counting. All of the other Pokémon run to hide, all but Togepi, who wanted to count with Pikachu. However, {{AP|Bulbasaur}} picks Togepi up with its vines and runs off. Oddish hides first, pretending to be a plant in the ground. The others quickly follow suit and soon all of them are hidden, with Donphan and Psyduck having difficulties. Larvitar sits this game out, still disgruntled. As soon as Pikachu is finished the counting, he runs off down a small flight of stone stairs, with Larvitar looking on, still angry. Meanwhile, {{MTR}} and {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} are mowing the lawns in the garden. As soon as Meowth states that they have the easiest job, the lawnmower breaks down, so Meowth decides he's finished mowing the lawn. Pikachu is now searching for the other Pokémon, looking through the garden. Pikachu wanders into the sunflower garden bed and finds Sunflora there, posing as a sunflower, and Sunflora becomes the first one out. Pikachu then finds Sandshrew backed against a brick wall pretending to be part of the wall. Sandshrew is the next Pokémon out. Pikachu soon finds Totodile, posing as part of a water feature in the garden, hiding underwater and shooting water up. Pikachu continues his search, when Larvitar suddenly pushes Donphan down a cliff and at Pikachu. Pikachu was able to escape the Donphan; however, Donphan wasn't so lucky and fell straight into a bush. Sadly, Donphan becomes the fourth Pokémon out. Pikachu then decides to look inside the mansion. He enters toward the living room first and spots Togepi on the couch, hiding in its shell and pretending to be a pillow. Pikachu tickles Togepi, getting it to come out. Togepi who was happy to be found by Pikachu gave it a bug hug. Pikachu and Togepi then comes to a small fireplace, where he sees the blue fur of a Cyndaquil who was using its flame to act like it's the fire of a fireplace. Pikachu and Togepi calls it out and Cyndaquil was the sixth Pokémon out. Pikachu soon discovers Granbull, Azurill, and Psyduck as well. Meanwhile, Larvitar angrily kicks a rock, which flies through the air and straight into the out-of-order lawnmower, turning it on and sending it tearing through the garden. Donphan and Bulbasaur, who emerges from its hiding place, attack the lawnmower, redirecting it, then Donphan charges at it, but gets blasted into the air. The lawnmower continues chasing everyone, almost running Oddish down, who hadn't been found yet. Pikachu runs outside and uses {{m|Thunderbolt}} on the lawnmower, which briefly turns off, but then turns itself back on and unleashes some chainsaws to its sides. Totodile hits the lawnmower with a {{m|Water Gun}} and Cyndaquil chases it down using {{m|Flamethrower}}, but the lawnmower jumps behind Cyndaquil, gaining the upper hand. As Meowth and Wobbuffet are preparing to clean the chimneys, they're beset by the rogue lawnmower. They run into the water, jumping across some islands, but the lawnmower chases them and mows down their chimney sweepers, although it breaks off its own chainsaws in the process, and sending them blasting off to land in the chminey. The lawnmower is now back to chasing all the other Pokémon, through a hedge maze. The Pokémon reach a dead end, resulting in a very close call for them, but they manage to escape. Eventually, Larvitar shows up and helps them out of the maze, then dropkicks the lawnmower, breaking it and shutting it down. The Pokémon casually walk out of the hedges, but suddenly the lawnmower bursts through the hedge, now with buzzsaws to its sides. They run away and climb up a tree, but the lawnmower cuts down the tree using the saws and continues pursuing them. The lawnmower chases them to the end of a short pier. All the Pokémon move out of the way just in time and cause the lawnmower dives right into the ocean, and Pikachu and Larvitar triumphantly throw some logs at it. Shockingly, the lawnmower starts itself up yet again, while underwater, and destroys the pier. The mower chases Pikachu and Togepi while all the other Pokémon come up with a plan to use firewood to make short pieces of track which force the lawnmower to make turns. This strategy works well until Psyduck trips up and fails to set its part of the track, but Bayleef suddenly intervenes and uses {{m|Vine Whip}} to throw the lawnmower back onto a track. They continue using logs to lead the lawnmower into a tool shed, where they shut and lock the door on it. After some ruckus inside the tool shed, they open the door to find that the lawnmower has finally been permanently shut down and will need repairs. Back in the garden, Kecleon comes out of hiding to find that everyone had stopped looking for it, making it the winner of the round, although it seemed confused of why Pikachu hadn't found it. The Pokémon work together to place the firewood back where it was before, and Bulbasaur and Bayleef trim some hedges into some topiaries of {{p|Onix}}, two {{p|Pichu}}, Pikachu, and Togepi. Larvitar and Togepi fix the stones that Larvitar was working on before. Back inside the mansion, Meowth and Wobbuffet fall through the chimney, and Meowth comments that they got the chimney sweeping done. The Pokémon start a new game of hide and seek, with Larvitar graciously accepting his role of 'it'. ==Major events== ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Larvitar}} * {{p|Corsola}} * {{p|Wailmer}} * {{p|Azurill}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Meowth}} ({{TRM}}) * {{p|Togepi}} ({{OP|Misty|Togetic}}) * {{p|Wobbuffet}} ({{OP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}}) * {{p|Bulbasaur}} ({{OP|Ash|Bulbasaur}}) * {{p|Bayleef}} ({{OP|Ash|Bayleef}}) * {{p|Cyndaquil}} ({{OP|Ash|Quilava}}) * {{p|Totodile}} ({{OP|Ash|Totodile}}) * {{p|Psyduck}} ({{OP|Misty|Psyduck}}) * {{p|Larvitar}} (debut) * {{p|Donphan}} * {{p|Sandshrew}} * {{p|Oddish}} * {{p|Kecleon}} * {{p|Granbull}} * {{p|Sunflora}} * {{p|Azurill}} (debut) * {{p|Yanma}} * {{p|Corsola}} (debut) * {{p|Wailmer}} (debut) * {{p|Sunkern}} * {{p|Chinchou}} ==Trivia== * This [[Pikachu short]] was never released in {{pmin|the United Kingdom}} or {{pmin|Italy}} nor on the VHS/DVD releases for unknown reasons. * {{p|Oddish}}'s English [[dub]] voice is recycled from ''[[EP137|Foul Weather Friends]]''. * This is the first Pikachu short to not include any human characters. * None of {{an|Brock}}'s Pokémon are featured in this Pikachu short. * The setting for this Pikachu short is largely based on {{wp|The Hamptons}} which is located on the eastern end of {{wp|Long Island}} in {{wp|New York (state)}}. ===Errors=== ===Dub edits=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=E66650|bordercolor=FFF7A5 |zh_yue={{tt|比卡超之捉迷藏|Pikachu's Hide-and-seek}} |zh_cmn={{tt|皮卡丘的心跳捉迷藏|Pikachu's Exciting Hide-and-seek}} |pt_br=O Pika-esconde de Pikachu }} ==External links== *[http://www.pokemon.co.jp/anime/movie/2001/pika.html Official website for ''Pikachu's PikaBoo''] (Japanese) ==Related articles== {{M04 navbox}} {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=PK09 | prevtitle=Snorlax Snowman | nextcode=PK11 | nexttitle=Camp Pikachu!
